result.stdout:
USAGE:
    wcom-pr-validation [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                     Prints help information                      
        --pr                       Pull request ID (overrides                   
                                   SYSTEM_PULLREQUEST_PULLREQUESTID environment 
                                   variable)                                    
        --repo                     Repository URI (overrides                    
                                   SYSTEM_PULLREQUEST_SOURCEREPOSITORYURI       
                                   environment variable)                        
        --pat                      Personal Access Token for Azure DevOps       
                                   (overrides AZDO_PAT environment variable)    
        --branch                   Source branch name (overrides                
                                   SYSTEM_PULLREQUEST_SOURCEBRANCH environment  
                                   variable)                                    
        --keep-repo                Keep the cloned repository directory (pr-src)
                                   after validation for debugging purposes      
        --verbose                  Output verbose/debug messages                
        --format                   Run dotnet format on the repository and      
                                   commit any changes back to the PR            
        --target-dir               Target directory where the cloned repository 
                                   (pr-src) should be placed (default: 'pr-src' 
                                   in current directory)                        
        --exclude-branch-prefix    Skip validation when the source branch name  
                                   starts with this prefix (repeatable).        
                                   Default: renovate/ when not specified
